Trails.Name: Lost in the Woods (Lower) Uphill Route
Lost in the Woods (Upper) Uphill Route

_inspectorSnowReport.Report:
Wednesday, November 18, 2026 1:40 PM – We currently have Broadway Express (1), Stump Alley Express (2), and Discovery Express (11) spinning. Unbound Express (6) and the Lower Panorama Gondola are on wind hold as strong winds build ahead of the storm. Snow is expected to develop over the next few hours, with visibility dropping and wind impacts to lift operations likely into the afternoon. If this storm delivers, our teams are planning to significantly expand terrain and will work to have lifts open out of Canyon Lodge by this Saturday. There is NO UPHILL SKIING OR SKINNING ACCESS anywhere on the resort at this time.

Upcoming Storm Cycle Expectations: Snow starts developing by late morning bringing strong, gusty winds along with it. Heavy snow continues tonight into Thursday, before skies clear on Friday. Follow along on our Storm Tracker.

Conditions: Windy and cold, with clouds thickening and snow developing by late morning. Soft, wind-affected snow on groomed runs early, turning to fresh snow as the storm builds.
Visibility: Good early, dropping as snow and blowing snow move in. Pack a low-light lens.
Lift Status: Broadway Express (1), Stump Alley Express (2), and Discovery Express (11) are currently spinning with Unbound Express (6) and the Lower Panorama Gondola currently on wind hold. There is no uphill skiing or skinning access anywhere on the resort.
Events: Austin Hope Wine Tasting at The Lakefront, 1 PM to 4 PM
Safety: Deep Snow Safety. As new snow piles up it can hide rocks, stumps and other early-season obstacles, so stay on open trails, keep your speed in check and ride with a partner who keeps you in sight. Visit our Safety page for more tips. Our on-mountain emergency hotline is: 760.934.0611
Road Conditions: Always be prepared for winter mountain driving and watch for icy patches in shaded areas. Check our Road Conditions page for the latest status.
_inspectorSnowReport.Alert: There is NO UPHILL SKIINNG/SKINNING ACCESS at this time.
